Class JsonArray

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.JsonArray
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonValue
public final class JsonArray extends Object implements JsonValue

A JSON array: values, in order.

An array parsed from a document is lazy: it creates each element on its first access, and keeps the document in memory while it is referenced. copyOf(JsonArray) makes a copy that does not.

Two arrays are equal when they have equal elements in the same order, as two Lists are.

Since:
0.1.0
